Compute Average Daily Gain (ADG) from Growth Curves

Source: R/calc_adg.R
calc_adg.Rd

Fit a growth curve to the cleaned body weights of each pig and compute average daily gain (ADG) over a body weight stage.

calc_adg(weight, qc = weight$settings, verbose = 1, cores = 1)

Arguments

weight

Result of clean_weight().

qc

QC settings; by default the ones used by clean_weight(). Used here: stage_range, curve_model, max_extrap_days.

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).

cores

Number of CPU cores for the per-pig computations. Default 1.

Value

An object of class ppt_adg (a list):

  • per_pig: one row per pig (pigs removed by clean_weight() are not included) with stage, curve_used, curve_r2, adg_type, start_date / end_date and start_weight / end_weight (when the curve reaches the stage limits, kg), stage_days, extrap_days_start / extrap_days_end (days the curve is extrapolated before the first / after the last weight), adg (g/d, slope of the daily weights over the stage), r_squared (of that regression), n_observed_days, n_interpolated_days, n_curve_days (stage days by source of the weight), adg_curve (g/d, stage weight difference / days of the growth curve, for comparison), weight_status and weight_reason (from clean_weight());

  • daily: one row per pig and day from start_date to end_date and over the recorded days: observed weight (daily median, kg, NA on days without valid weight), weight_filled (observed, interpolated or curve weight, kg), source ("observed", "interpolated" or "curve"), predicted weight of the growth curve with lower / upper limits (± 1.96 residual SD) and in_stage;

  • removed: pigs removed so far, plus pigs without ADG;

  • settings: QC settings.

See also

clean_weight() for the previous step.

Examples

visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
w <- clean_weight(visits, verbose = 0)
adg <- calc_adg(w)
#> 
#> ── ADG over 30-120 kg (poly2 curve) ────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Observed (stage inside the records): 21
#> • Extrapolated: 7
#> • Partial (stage not fully reached): 1
#> • No ADG: 0
#> ! 1 pig does not reach the whole stage: ADG is based on part of it (adg_type = "partial").
#> ✔ Mean ADG: 1205 g/d (SD 133)
head(adg$per_pig[, .(responder, adg_type, start_date, end_date, stage_days, adg)])
#>    responder     adg_type start_date   end_date stage_days      adg
#>       <char>       <char>     <Date>     <Date>      <num>    <num>
#> 1:     13913     observed 2024-03-02 2024-05-16   75.56102 1209.897
#> 2:     13918     observed 2024-03-06 2024-05-24   78.43858 1162.966
#> 3:     13954 extrapolated 2024-03-10 2024-05-28   79.28093 1124.224
#> 4:     13996     observed 2024-02-28 2024-05-07   69.15285 1334.979
#> 5:     14962     observed 2024-02-26 2024-05-07   70.15055 1278.746
#> 6:     15006     observed 2024-02-28 2024-05-07   68.69428 1317.472

# Gompertz curve, with quadratic fallback
adg_g <- calc_adg(w, qc = qc_config(curve_model = "gompertz"), verbose = 0)
table(adg_g$per_pig$curve_used)
#> 
#> gompertz 
#>       29 

# Source of the daily weights over the stage
table(adg$daily[in_stage == TRUE, source])
#> 
#>        curve interpolated     observed 
#>           35           12         2158
